text:
alex: Morning—quick sync. Pricing/packaging change (v2 plan table) lands next week; we need owners for metering hooks, gateway header mapping, quota enforcement, and contract exceptions. Who can take what?

maria: I can take metering events + plan->quota mapping. Need billing to confirm invoice line-item names.

simon: Gateway auth/headers are on eng-infra, but eng-platform will wire the mapping endpoint. Who's owning plan_id -> quota lookup logic?

maria: I will own the lookup logic. Note: enterprise grandfathered plans have custom quotas — we'll need a contract exceptions list. @nora can you surface those?

nora: Yep. I'll export contract exceptions (customers with overrides) and include whether they are token-capped vs request-capped. ETA EOD.

alex: Timeline: want prod-ready canary by next Tue (3 business days). Action items now: maria -> metering events + mapping PR; simon -> gateway header + endpoint; nora -> contract exceptions CSV; alex -> billing validation + canary.

simon: Quick note: our quota library currently supports per-minute and per-second windows only. We'll add a per-month token bucket for this rollout — estimate ~1 day to implement + tests.

maria: Understood. I'll design events to include token_count and usage_unit so billing can aggregate per-month.

billing-bot: invoice-preview job completed on staging. Result: label mismatch for line-item "premium-embeddings" vs our SKU "premium_embeddings".

maria: Thanks @billing-bot — that's the mapping I planned to change. I'll update mapping: premium_embeddings -> premium-embeddings in the next commit.

alex: Simon, any infra/network blocks for adding header passthrough?

simon: One potential: api-gateway strips unknown headers by default. Need an ingress config change to whitelist x-plan-id. Ops will need to approve an ingress policy change. Estimate ~2-3 hours ops work.

nora: Contract CSV will include columns: customer_id, plan_id, quota_override, billing_unit, notes. I'll flag customers with negotiated token conversion rates.

alex: Good. Please attach CSV to the PR or this thread when ready. Also include regression prompt tests for quota changes.

maria: Creating PR now with event schema + mapping tests. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/packaging/pull/468

billing-bot: billing-test-run: staging/invoice-preview/2026-11-12 — 1 mismatch (premium-embeddings).

simon: When PR merges, please ping me. I'll run e2e for quota enforcement in staging and validate monthly bucket behavior.

nora: Uploaded CSV: https://internal/redwood/contracts/exception_export_2026-11-12.csv — 14 customers.

alex: Owners set: metering = maria, gateway = simon, contracts = nora, billing validation = alex. If no blockers, we'll proceed on timeline. Ping here with updates. :thumbsup:
__pov: engineering coordination thread for pricing/packaging change implementation dependencies
